moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season & Community Shield Build-Up
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are in full swing with pre-season matches, preparing for the 2026/27 season which kicks off on August 21st. The curtain-raiser, the Community Shield between Manchester City and Arsenal, is set for August 16th in Cardiff.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Pre-season action
angles.copy: Pre-season action is heating up! Who are you backing for the Community Shield next week, Man City or Arsenal?

angles.name: Season kick-off anticipation
angles.copy: August 21st marks the start of the new Premier League season. What's your top prediction for the 26/27 title?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Make Chart History
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean have made UK chart history with 'Rein Me In', which has now spent 19 non-consecutive weeks at No.1, becoming the longest-running UK No.1 single of all time as of the chart dated August 6th, 2026.

angles.name: Record-breaking achievement
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK No.1 single ever. What a tune!

angles.name: Listener engagement on current hit
angles.copy: 19 weeks and counting! Is 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean your favourite chart-topper right now?

moments.blurb: The brand-new 'Palace Bowl Presents' festival series is currently underway at the iconic Crystal Palace Bowl in London, featuring an eclectic lineup of global headliners until August 16th.

angles.name: London event highlight
angles.copy: London, get ready! Palace Bowl Presents is bringing a stacked line-up to Crystal Palace Bowl until August 16th. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Summer festival vibes
angles.copy: Summer vibes in South London! The 'Palace Bowl Presents' series is live now with incredible artists. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Medicine Festival Begins Next Week
moments.blurb: Medicine Festival, a unique gathering celebrating indigenous wisdom, sacred ceremony, live music, and workshops, takes place from August 12th-17th in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset.

angles.name: Unique festival experience
angles.copy: Looking for something a little different? Medicine Festival kicks off next week in Dorset, blending music, wellness, and wisdom. Who's heading there?

angles.name: Beyond mainstream festivals
angles.copy: Beyond the mainstream: Medicine Festival is on from August 12th-17th in Dorset. A unique experience awaits!

moments.title: Happy 54th Birthday, Geri Halliwell!
moments.blurb: Today, August 6th, marks the 54th birthday of pop icon Geri Halliwell-Horner, famously known as Ginger Spice from the Spice Girls (born 1972).

angles.name: Pop icon tribute
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Geri Halliwell! Still got that zig-a-zig-ah.
